proof_summary: A pair-word renormalization of the run-length recursion yields positive auxiliary sequences satisfying exact coupled recurrences, from which one obtains \(p(m+n)\le 16p(m)p(n)\) and the bounds \(2p(n-11)\le a_n\le17664p(n-11)\). Hence \(\log(16p(n))\) is subadditive, so Fekete’s lemma gives convergence of \(\log p(n)/n\); the constant-factor bounds transfer this limit to \(\log a_n/n\), and exponentiation gives the desired root limit.
